collection.title: INEOS Grenadier 2022 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a INEOS Grenadier 2022 Onwards model which requires a 16" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
